title: Villa Treville vs Borgo Santandrea: Private Estate or Statement? (2026) | Suites With Keith
description: Villa Treville vs Borgo Santandrea, compared by a travel advisor who toured both in October 2026: a private estate near Positano or the modern statement above Conca dei Marini, privacy, rooms, beaches and who each one suits.

hero.alt: A wisteria-covered terrace lounge at Villa Treville looking across the bay to the cliffs of Positano
Borgo Santandrea on the cliffs above Conca dei Marini

sub: Two hotels that feel like nowhere else on the coast. One is an eclectic private estate just outside Positano; the other is very modern, above Conca dei Marini. Here is how I would choose.

choose.h3: If you want a private estate near Positano
choose.lead: Probably the most private rooms in Positano, no two alike, eclectic art, warm service and three boats with free shuttles into town.
choose.alt: A pink villa with arched windows and palms at Villa Treville

choose.h3: If you want a modern statement and a real beach
choose.lead: Spectacular and very modern, above Conca dei Marini, with a beautiful, massive, proper beach, fantastic dining at Alici and refined but warm service.
choose.alt: Borgo Santandrea on the cliffs above Conca dei Marini

pitch: Work with me and you get Fora perks, plus someone who knows these hotels personally and personalizes your stay: I match you to the right room at Villa Treville, steer you away from the overlooked pool rooms at Borgo Santandrea, and arrange the boats and transfers. Same rate as booking direct.

paras: Villa Treville has probably the most private rooms in all of Positano. It feels more like a private estate on the cliffs than a hotel, and every room is completely different.
Borgo Santandrea is spectacular and very modern, with a proper beach. But its private pool rooms are not that private: you can look down on your neighbors, and they can look down on you.
If privacy is the point, pick Villa Treville. If you want a modern statement and a real beach, pick Borgo Santandrea, and let me choose the room.

guide.alt: A rain shower falling from a brick-domed ceiling into a round mosaic-tiled shower at Villa Treville
paras: At Villa Treville, every room is completely different, so the match matters. Tell me your style and I will get you into the right one. The suite with the outdoor tub and shower is a standout, with one of the coolest showers I have ever seen: a rain shower falling from an old brick dome.
At Borgo Santandrea, the rooms are very modern. Think twice before booking one with a private pool, because they are overlooked. Tell me what matters to you and I will request the right room.

guide.alt: Loungers on the rocks over the sea at the Villa Treville beach club
paras: Villa Treville has a beach club on the rocks, right on the water, and three stunning boats with free shuttles into Positano.
Borgo Santandrea has a beautiful, massive, proper beach. The sun leaves the water early, so in the fall your swim time ends around 4:30 or 5pm. Come in May to June, or September.

guide.alt: Treatment beds behind black iron lattice screens on hand-painted tiles in the Villa Treville spa
paras: Service at Villa Treville was fantastic and warm, from people who clearly love the place. The spa is in an iron-and-glass garden pavilion that opens to the sea.
At Borgo Santandrea, service is refined but warm, and dinner at Alici is fantastic.

guide.alt: Positano across turquoise water, framed by an umbrella pine, from Villa Treville
paras: Villa Treville sits on the cliffs just outside Positano, a boat ride from town, so you get the privacy and the scene when you want it.
Borgo Santandrea is above Conca dei Marini, just along the coast from Amalfi, on the quieter side of the coast.

faq.q: Which is better, Villa Treville or Borgo Santandrea?
faq.a: For privacy, Villa Treville, which has probably the most private rooms in Positano. For a modern, spectacular statement with a proper beach, Borgo Santandrea.
Villa Treville. At Borgo Santandrea, the private pool rooms are overlooked: you can look down on your neighbors, and they can look down on you.
Borgo Santandrea: beautiful, massive and a proper beach. Villa Treville has a beach club on the rocks, right on the water, plus three boats.

faq.q: Which room should I book at each?
faq.a: At Villa Treville, it depends on your style, because every room is completely different; the suite with the outdoor tub and shower is a standout. At Borgo Santandrea, ask me first, and think twice about a private pool room.
For Borgo Santandrea, May to June, or September. In the fall, the sun leaves its water early, and your swim time ends around 4:30 or 5pm.
